property_summary: For any newOwner address, the reference contract rejects setting owner to the zero address (transferOwnership(address(0)) reverts) while the mutant allows transferring ownership to the zero address (succeeds), so the reference always prevents owner becoming address(0) but the mutant can make owner == address(0) for some input.
change_summary: Remove the check that newOwner is not the zero address, allowing transferOwnership(address(0)).
